core_obligations: Build the inductive tower of free graded algebras
Adjoin generators to kill the stray cohomology classes
Prove the quasi-isomorphism via the colimit of cohomology
difficulty_reason: Existence of a good differential graded algebra quasi-isomorphic to a given one: the author says the argument mirrors the first proof of lemma-resolve with free graded algebras instead of free graded modules and then performs it in full - constructing A_0 -> A_1 -> ... -> B inside the ambient algebra, adjoining generators to kill the classes in H^n(A_i) not mapping into H^n(B), and proving the quasi-isomorphism from H^n(A) = colim H^n(A_i) with the kernel of each step annihilated in the next; the flatness clause is referred to lemma-special-good. Retained author proof at lines 5770-5830.

compared.note: Not a bare restatement: the construction is written out for the algebra case here. Module analogue is lemma-resolve (separate card).
